text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — dashboard sample in the console observability quickstart is showing the old trace metric and the cost/latency matrix is using milliseconds but the label says 's'. Small doc bug but will confuse customers. Example link I tried: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/console/observability/dashboard-examples.md#latency-matrix (404?)

Jon H: ah thanks. I saw a failing linkcheck yesterday. which file/line? can you paste the snippet?

Maya Patel: sure, copied from the page:
```json
{
  "widgets": [
    {
      "type": "matrix",
      "title": "Cost / Latency",
      "metric": "redwood.trace.latency_s",
      "unit": "s"
    }
  ]
}
```

Priya S: We renamed the metric during metricsv2 to `redwood.obsv.trace.latency_ms`. The snippet should use ms, and the label should be `ms`. Also the python SDK sample is dividing by 1000 (`/1000`) to convert — that should be removed.

Leo Zhang: I'll open a PR to fix the snippet + broken link. pinging @docs-bot for linkcheck :thumbsup: 

Anita Gomez: if you can, add a tiny note about units in the migration guide. we've been getting tickets where customers misread latency as seconds.

docs-bot: Link Check: 1 broken link found in dashboard-examples.md -> /console/obs/old-path (reported at 2501112230)

Jon H: thanks bot. @Leo can you include the link fix and a unit comment in one PR? if small we can merge fast.

Leo Zhang: Yep. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12987 — contains metric rename, unit correction in YAML/JSON sample, and updated python + go snippets. PTAL @Priya S @Maya Patel

Priya S: quick note: python snippet uses `sdk.v1.TracingHook()` call; after the rename the param name changed from `trace_metric` to `metric_name`. update that too.

Leo Zhang: Good catch. I'll update.

Maya Patel: I ran the sample locally — renders fine once you change units, but the dashboard image snapshot used in the doc still references the old metric id. i'll attach a new rendered screenshot to the PR in a sec.

Jon H: also add a changelog entry under `docs: observability` for history.

Leo Zhang: Will do. Requesting review from @Anita Gomez and @Jon H. aiming for tiny change, merge by EOD. :rocket:

Anita Gomez: :thumbsup: reviewing now

deploy-bot: Preview site deployed: https://deploy-preview-12987--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/dashboard-examples (snapshot ready) (2501112330)

Anita Gomez: Looks good in preview. two tiny copy nits in the paragraph above the sample: change "latency is measured in ms" -> "latency is measured in milliseconds" and remove a stray backtick.

Leo Zhang: fixed nits in PR.

Anita Gomez: LGTM. merging after CI. :checkered_flag:

docs-bot: Pull request merged: #12987 by LeoZ (2501112340)

Maya Patel: :tada: thanks all — will close the related support ticket.
